mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.password, u.name, u.enabled, u.created_at, u.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user u WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM app_user u WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT ur.user_id, r.id AS r_id, r.code AS r_code, r.name AS r_name, r.description AS r_description, r.all_permissions_yn AS r_all_permissions_yn, r.used_yn AS r_used_yn, r.built_in_yn AS r_built_in_yn, r.created_at AS r_created_at, r.updated_at AS r_updated_at FROM app_user_role ur JOIN app_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id IN #{id} ORDER BY ur.user_id, r.code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user u JOIN app_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN app_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND r.all_permissions_yn = 'Y' AND r.used_yn = 'Y'

where.if: AND (u.username LIKE #{keywordLower} ESCAPE '!' OR u.name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = #{c.roleId})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (username, password, name, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
